source_ownership: operator native serving-image launch; current live image digest/process ancestor tree not directly inspected

primary_sources.contract: npm start is a normal native command; restart preserves running config and uses zero-downtime replacement; app SIGTERM allows completing in-flight requests during configured shutdown delay

primary_sources.mechanism: namespace init exiting causes remaining namespace processes to be killed; parent exit can remove a child before its graceful handler drains
orphan descendants can be adopted and waited for by a designated ancestor

scope: functional owned Free Node web restart/in-flight POST and signal handler; no privileged cluster access or shared rollout
proposal: primary Node serving launch must forward termination to its child process group and keep its supervisor alive until terminating descendants finish, delivering the configured grace; reuse static helper artifact delivery through the existing Bex image, preserve exact shell/command/PATH/env/exit behavior, audit overrides and keep static/opaque/other-primary scope explicit
